# Project Maya — Technical Summary

**Project Maya** is an open-source (MIT) local inference engine for large MoE models, primarily **GLM-5.3-Flash** (321B/18B active), **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017**, and **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash**, running on consumer hardware via a three-tier memory system (VRAM expert cache / pinned RAM / SSD streaming).

## Core architecture
- **Expert tiering**: 95% of parameters are routed experts; hot experts go to VRAM, the rest to pinned RAM or NVMe,
